notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 65-year-old female admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.79, creatinine 0.93-0.96, hemoglobin 11.5-13, platelets 198-202, sodium 140-141, wbc 8.8-9.5; vitals dbp 64-69, heart_rate 69-74, map 84-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 122-129, spo2 96-98, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: bleeding duodenal ulcer, treated with endoscopic clips; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Anemia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.93-0.98, hemoglobin 10.2-11.1, platelets 192-197, sodium 141, wbc 8.9-9.4; vitals dbp 64-67, heart_rate 70-73, map 83-87, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 122-129, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Transfuse 1 unit packed red blood cells
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Anemia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 65-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Anemia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
